description:
Dagger Directive leaves early access and version 1.0 will be available on August 13, 2026. Watch the Dagger Directive version 1.0 release date trailer for this upcoming tactical FPS game. Version 1.0 of Dagger Directive will introduce a new update, including the Global Ops expansion featuring a new campaign with five new missions, new enemy encounters, and additional locations to explore.

Whether infiltrating enemy compounds under the cover of darkness or launching a full-scale assault, success depends on planning, precision, and adaptability.

author: GameTrailers
description:
Ancient. Immortal. Unstoppable. Get a deep dive into the gameplay of the Necron faction in this latest Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4 trailer for the upcoming real-time strategy game. Witness the return of the Necrons as they restore their tombs, expand their domain to earn their Dominion resource across Kronus, and awaken ancient engines of war. 

As the Necron reclaim Kronus, they expand their domain to earn resources across the battlefield by restoring ancient structures and activating their Power Matrix, steadily turning the war in their favor. At the center of their growing empire stands the Tomb Citadel, which also serves as the production engine for your units. 

Leading their forces are two powerful commanders: the Chronomancer Thothmek, who bends time to disrupt enemies and accelerate Necron reanimation, and Ahmnok, once ruler of Kronus, consumed entirely by the urge to annihilate all life. 

With self-repairing legions, unyielding constructs, and ancient technologies that b

author: GameTrailers
description:
Join co-founder and executive producer Jean-Francois Boivin from developer Panache Digital Games for a closer look at 1666: Amsterdam in this new video for the upcoming third-person action-adventure game. Meet the dual protagonists of 1666: Amsterdam, as Boivin dives into the background of these two characters: Noa and Aaron. We learn about Noa's mystical tools and Aaron's perspective in his new form. 1666: Amsterdam will be available on PC. The prologue is available to play now on Steam and Epic Games Store.

Every 333 years, something stirs. 1666: Amsterdam is a 3rd person Dark, Story-Led, Action-Adventure where Noa, the Collector, wields witchcraft to uncover demonic entities hiding behind human faces. Investigate by day. Face your demons at night.
title: 1666: Amsterdam - Official Dual Protagonists: Gameplay Feature Video #2

author: GameTrailers
description:
Join the development team at Limbic Entertainment for a closer look at gameplay and more from Corsair Cove in this latest trailer for the upcoming pirate-themed city-builder game. In this new, exclusive 15-minute video of developer-narrated gameplay, take a tour of the Ship Graveyard island and Devil's Basin island. Learn about the challenges these islands bring as you work to build your pirate base, including environmental challenges, resource management, raiding, resource distribution, and much more. Corsair Cove will be available on Steam, Epic Games Store, and Xbox on PC on July 31, 2026.

In Corsair Cove, build a sprawling pirate haven, raise a fleet to explore the high seas, and take on the Crown to keep the Age of Piracy alive! From ale to flintlock pistols, and from scallywags to swashbucklers, you’ll need to manage complex production chains and govern a rowdy crew to reign supreme over the seas!
title: Corsair Cove - Official Gameplay Overview Trailer
